stopPoints.label: Music lesson starts with Madame Gazelle
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Dialogue): What musical instrument is Madame Gazelle playing for the class?
Options:
A) A guitar 🎸
B) A drum 🥁
Guidance: Encourage the child to look at Madame Gazelle and say: 'A guitar!'

stopPoints.label: Pedro coughs and interrupts the song
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action & Dialogue): Who started coughing during the music lesson?
Options:
A) Pedro Pony 🐴
B) Peppa Pig 🐷
Guidance: Ask the child who coughed: 'Pedro Pony!'

stopPoints.label: Madame Gazelle rings the doctor
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Dialogue): Who is Madame Gazelle calling on the phone?
Options:
A) Dr. Brown Bear 🐻
B) Grandpa Pig 👴
Guidance: Prompt the child: 'Dr. Brown Bear!'

stopPoints.label: Dr. Brown Bear answers the emergency call
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual): What color is the telephone on Dr. Brown Bear's desk?
Options:
A) Green 🟢
B) Red 🔴
Guidance: Have the child point to the telephone and say: 'Green!'

stopPoints.label: Dr. Brown Bear drives through the traffic
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual): What vehicle is Dr. Brown Bear driving with a flashing light?
Options:
A) An ambulance car 🚑
B) A big bicycle 🚲
Guidance: Encourage the child to identify the vehicle: 'An ambulance!'

stopPoints.label: Pedro explains his cough to the doctor
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue): What does Pedro say is the matter with him?
Options:
A) He has got a cough 🗣️
B) His foot hurts 🦶
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'I\'ve got a cough!'

stopPoints.label: Pedro explains when his cough started
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue): When does Pedro say his cough started?
Options:
A) When Madame Gazelle started singing 🎶
B) At lunchtime 🥪
Guidance: Ask the child: 'When Madame Gazelle started singing!'

stopPoints.label: Dr. Brown Bear explains catching coughs
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue): What does Dr. Brown Bear say Pedro's cough might be?
Options:
A) Catching (contagious) 🤧
B) Very loud 📢
Guidance: Encourage the child to repeat the key word: 'Catching!'

stopPoints.label: Dr. Brown Bear gives Pedro medicine
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual): What color is the cough medicine bottle Dr. Brown Bear holds?
Options:
A) Pink 🩷
B) Blue 💙
Guidance: Prompt the child to name the color: 'Pink!'

stopPoints.label: Pedro describes the taste of the medicine
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue): What funny thing does Pedro say the medicine tastes like?
Options:
A) An old shoe full of jam 👟🍓
B) Sweet chocolate cake 🍫🍰
Guidance: Laugh together and say: 'An old shoe full of jam!'

stopPoints.label: Danny Dog and Suzy Sheep catch the cough
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Dialogue): Which two friends caught Pedro's cough next?
Options:
A) Danny Dog and Suzy Sheep 🐶🐑
B) Candy Cat and Zoe Zebra 🐱🦓
Guidance: Encourage the child to identify the two coughing friends: 'Danny and Suzy!'

stopPoints.label: Suzy and Danny taste the medicine
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue): What does Danny Dog say his spoonful of medicine tastes of?
Options:
A) Flowers 🌸
B) Bananas 🍌
Guidance: Encourage the child to recall Danny's reaction: 'Flowers!'

stopPoints.label: Dr. Brown Bear eats an apple
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Dialogue): What healthy fruit does Dr. Brown Bear eat every day to stay well?
Options:
A) A green apple 🍏
B) An orange 🍊
Guidance: Have the child point to the apple and say: 'An apple a day!'

stopPoints.label: Parents pick up the children at home time
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual): What is ringing at the top of the school roof when school ends?
Options:
A) A yellow school bell 🔔
B) A clock ⏰
Guidance: Ask the child to spot the item on top of the school: 'A school bell!'

stopPoints.label: All grown-ups start coughing together
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action & Dialogue): Who caught Pedro's cough after the children told their story?
Options:
A) All the grown-ups 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
B) The birds outside 🐦
Guidance: Encourage the child to answer: 'All the grown-ups!'

stopPoints.label: All the parents take their medicine
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue): What does Mummy Pig say the medicine tastes like?
Options:
A) Custard and old socks 🧦🍮
B) Strawberries and cream 🍓🍦
Guidance: Have fun with the silly description: 'Custard and old socks!'

stopPoints.label: Dr. Brown Bear catches the cough himself
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action & Visual): Oh dear! Who starts coughing while leaving the classroom?
Options:
A) Dr. Brown Bear 🐻
B) Peppa Pig 🐷
Guidance: Prompt the child: 'Dr. Brown Bear!'

stopPoints.label: The children visit Dr. Brown Bear in bed
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Dialogue): What special outfit is Suzy Sheep wearing while giving medicine to Dr. Brown Bear?
Options:
A) A nurse costume with a white hat 👩‍⚕️
B) A fairy costume with wings 🧚
Guidance: Ask the child to look at Suzy's white hat and cross: 'A nurse!'
